_comment: The machine-readable definition of the blind/informed cut. scripts/blind.sh copies tier-0 only; tests/test_tier_isolation.py enforces that tier 0 stays clean. Paths are glob patterns relative to the repo root, matched against forward-slash paths.
_readme_note: README.md is tier 1: its job is to advertise what the lab found, which is exactly what a blind agent must not see. Orientation for a blind copy comes from AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and the generated MODE file.
